## Vacancy staleness monitor (report only)

**NOT imported into or tested on a running n8n instance.** Written from n8n documentation and source.

Once a day it reads the public vacancies API and lists every vacancy that is shown as unconfirmed, has no verification date, or was last verified more than 14 days ago. The 14 days is VACANCY_STALE_DAYS (packages/schemas/src/content.ts, used by vacancyDisplay and A6 in packages/automation/src/vacancy.ts). Exactly 14 days is not stale.

It only reports. It never edits a vacancy and never marks one available: only a person who knows the real situation can confirm availability, and publishing stays a human step.

Environment variables: SITE_BASE_URL, NOTIFY_FROM_ADDRESS, VACANCY_NOTIFY_ADDRESS.
